correctness.rationale: For the Lindbladian defined with offdiagonal rate gamma and a one-site absorber population loss kappa, Hilbert–Schmidt dissipation and graph connectivity exclude imaginary-axis eigenoperators, giving exponential absorption. Taking integrated equations of eight invariant permutation-symmetric real density amplitudes recovers the all-size rational mean T. Positive coefficients A,B,C and direct derivatives give unique fixed-kappa gamma optimum, its strict decrease in kappa, asymptotic endpoints, and positive-definite joint Hessian plus coercivity. Boundary p=1 yields T=N/kappa without unique gamma. Independently constructed full N^2 Liouvillian and directly solved 60 cases across part sizes/rates/mixtures with errors below 1e-8. Finite checks corroborate but do not certify the general algebra.
